news.title: NSF renews Quantum Leap Challenge Institute with $37.5 million investment in quantum sensing for biology
news.summary_en: University of Chicago-led institute will advance quantum sensors toward robust tools for revealing biological processes beyond the reach of conventional measurement

news.title: NSF renews region’s two Quantum Leap Challenge Institutes, each with $37.5M in funding
news.summary_en: Five-year investments in UChicago-led QuBBE and UIUC-led HQAN advance quantum sensing for biology, industry-ready quantum computing, and workforce development

news.title: Illinois-led regional quantum hub NSF HQAN renewed to pursue industry-ready computing and workforce development
news.summary_en: The NSF has awarded $37.5 million over five years to the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign-led NSF HQAN, one of the original three NSF Quantum Leap Challenge Institutes, to continue advancing quantum science and technology across the Midwest.
